einzeiler: Linda Cardellini talks about her Emmy win, early acting days, and iconic roles.
kurzfassung: Linda Cardellini joins the podcast to discuss her Emmy-winning role in DTF St. Louis and her extensive career across film and television. She shares entertaining stories from her time on The Price is Right, working on ER, and navigating major productions like Avengers and Mad Men. The conversation also touches on her upcoming projects, including Crystal Lake and Way of the Warrior Kid.
stichpunkte: Linda Cardellini reflects on her recent Emmy win for her performance in DTF St. Louis.
She recalls winning a fireplace and appearing as a contestant on The Price is Right during college.
The hosts discuss her early acting start in community theater and school plays in Northern California.
She talks about the intense memorization and choreography required for her multi-year run on ER.
Cardellini shares behind-the-scenes memories from working on major projects like Mad Men, Avengers, and Bloodline.
She discusses her role as Pamela Voorhees in the upcoming Friday the 13th prequel series Crystal Lake.
She talks about working with Chris Pratt in the upcoming Apple TV project Way of the Warrior Kid.

clips.text: The guest achieved a notable game show victory decades prior to her major acting success.

clips.hook: Ditching class to wait in line
clips.text: A group of college students skipped their lectures to line up at dawn for a chance to get onto a television game show.
A newcomer to Los Angeles unknowingly signed up for an unverified jailhouse film project involving skimpy outfits and grueling conditions.

clips.hook: Filming intimate scenes on day one
clips.text: Two actors who had barely met in a parking garage were immediately scheduled to shoot a bizarre physical sequence on their first morning together.
